results.title:
Thailand’s Cabinet has approved three major cooperation initiatives with China in the automotive industry, fresh fruit exports, and vocational education.

The initiatives aim to promote investment and innovation in electric and smart vehicles, set export standards for Thai fresh durians and sala fruits to ensure quality and safety, and upgrade vocational training in AI, rail transportation, automotive technology, smart manufacturing, and new energy.

The five-year agreements are expected to be signed during the Chinese Prime Minister’s visit to Thailand from November 13–15, 2026.
